diagnostic_evidence.quote: The dual space $Y_R'$ is the corresponding conormal-data space.

issues.failure_explanation: For an open arc, the dual of H^{1/2}(Gamma_R) is H^{-1/2}(Gamma_R), not H^{-1/2}_{00}(Gamma_R). The space H^{-1/2}_{00}(Gamma_R) is the dual of the smaller subspace H^{1/2}_{00}(Gamma_R). The displayed equality is therefore false; the intended space is the conormal-data space H^{-1/2}_{00}, but the parenthetical identification with the dual is incorrect.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Remove the false equality and define Y_R' := H^{-1/2}_{00}(Gamma_R) directly as the conormal-data space, or replace it by H^{-1/2}(Gamma_R) if the dual is intended.
issues.overall_effect: The function-space identification is mathematically wrong, but the paper consistently uses Y_R' as H^{-1/2}_{00} for compactly supported data, so the formal results and guarantees are not invalidated.
issues.title: False identification of the dual of H^{1/2}(Gamma_R)
issues.why_classification: The false displayed identification is a concrete mathematical error, but the intended space is clear and all subsequent uses are consistent with H^{-1/2}_{00}; no theorem, rate, or guarantee is lost.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: The unit normal \(\nu\) points to the exterior of \(\mathbb R^2_{\Sigma,+}\), i.e. downward on the flat part of the boundary.

issues.failure_explanation: On the flat PML segment, alpha_2=1 and A_sigma=diag(1/alpha_1, alpha_1). With nu downward, the global conormal is nu·A_sigma·grad u = -alpha_1 ∂_n u. The local model instead defines ∂_{ν_σ,±}=+alpha_1 ∂_n, the opposite sign. Hence the local upper Robin problem solves alpha_1 ∂_n v - Z v = r instead of the global -alpha_1 ∂_n v - Z v = r, so Q_{σ,t} approximates a different operator. The coupling check in the proof of lem:QBim-correction-separated, which cancels the Robin data using the local model's Robin relation, is invalid as written.

failure_location.quote: On \(n=0\) we use the same conormal convention as in the jump formula, namely \(\partial_{\nu_\sigma,-}w:=\alpha_1\partial_n w(s,0^-)\) and \(\partial_{\nu_\sigma,+}w:=\alpha_1\partial_n w(s,0^+)\).

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Correct the local model's conormal to ∂_{ν_σ,±}=-alpha_1 ∂_n (equivalently flip the sign of the Robin condition), update the symbol in lem:flat-symbol-ratio to -(tau_sigma+Z)/(tau_sigma-Z) (the same absolute-value bound holds), and rerun the coupling check with the consistent sign.
issues.overall_effect: The correction estimate ||chi_im(Q_sigma-Q_{sigma,t})f_sigma|| <= C P(bar_sigma) sum ||U_{sigma,t}^±|| is not proved; lem:QBim-family, cor:Ainv-Bim-small, and thm:computable-convergence depend on this correction.
issues.title: Wrong conormal sign in the local flat PML model
issues.why_classification: The repair is contained to the local model definition and the correction-lemma proof; no new global architecture is needed and the main convergence theorem survives, but a nontrivial proof step must be redone.

issues.failure_explanation: Lemma lem:QBim-family's final bound gives only O(bar_sigma_0^{-1/2}) times the weighted norm of the input. Applied to phi_sigma^0, this yields O(bar_sigma_0^{-1/2} P(bar_sigma) ||g||), not the exponential bound claimed. The exponential bound requires the sharper intermediate estimates inside the proof of lem:QBim-family (eq:QBim-fixed-weighted-proof and eq:QBim-unweighted-family) together with the tail smallness of chi_im phi_sigma^0; the theorem's proof does not spell out this step.

failure_location.quote: For the nearest-image term \({\cal B}_{\sigma}^{\rm im}\), as \(\mathcal B_\sigma^{\rm im}\) only sees \(\chi_{\rm im}\phi_\sigma^0\), \eqref{eq:exact-physical-family-tail-small}, Lemma~\ref{lem:Bim-unweighted}, and Lemma~\ref{lem:QBim-family} give \eqref{eq:Ainv-Bim-phi0-small}.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Insert the sharper estimates from the proof of lem:QBim-family, namely ||Q_sigma B_sigma^im phi_sigma^0||_{Y_R} <= C P(bar_sigma) bar_sigma^{-1/2} ||chi_im phi_sigma^0|| and W_sigma||chi_im Q_sigma B_sigma^im phi_sigma^0|| <= C(bar_sigma^{-1/2}+P(bar_sigma)e^{-c_b bar_sigma}) W_sigma||chi_im phi_sigma^0||, and combine with eq:exact-physical-family-tail-small.
issues.overall_effect: The density convergence estimate eq:density-convergence is not fully justified at the cited step; the field estimate eq:field-convergence inherits the gap.
issues.title: Incomplete justification of the nearest-image term in the main convergence proof
issues.why_classification: The missing step is a short clarification using estimates already present in the source; the conclusion and all guarantees survive.
